rules.statement: The court held that tenants of the affected property have locus standi to apply for relief and that other tenants who would be adversely affected by a demolition order are necessary parties.
rules.supporting_quote: "I cannot agree with this submission. The petitioners have a locus standi to apply to this Court for relief. They have come to Court on the footing that premises Nos. 126 and 128 are not affected properties and have not vested in the State, that the 2nd respondent is still the owner thereof and they are still the tenants of the premise and protected by the Rent Act. They are aggrieved parties who say that the demolition order will affect their rights and interests."

meta.parties: Muzamil and Others v. Rehabilitian of Property and Industries Authority(Repia) and Others
